painpoints.text: Engine host-hook transport hides cwd: petri's host_command (executors.rs) sets the hook cwd only when shares_host_filesystem() — false for the Docker provider — so any [[run.hooks]] sandbox=false entry CANNOT reference repo files at all (run 01M4EQ01KZXE2DZ9PPSJHXGMN4, 12 silent exit-1s). Suggestion: an engine-side FABRO_HOOK_WORKSPACE env var (or a bundle-file staging dir for host hooks) would let host hooks reference script files instead of embedding bytes; until then every host-side hook must carry its script inline.

nu footguns cost two debug cycles in .fabro/scripts/judgment-shadow.nu: `def f [x]: string -> string` declares INPUT type (calling without piping errors 'no input value piped in'), `describe` returns 'record<...>' not 'record', and single-quoted nu strings do not interpret \n (my workflow.toml comment insertion silently no-op'd). Suggest a lint-nu note or battery fixture documenting these three for future loop edits.
